paragraphs.source_en: I’ll miss you though, Mustang. More than I’ve admitted until now.

ja.t: しくなるよ、マスタング。

units.source_en: More than I’ve admitted until now.

paragraphs.source_en: Fog and shadows are my vision. For a moment, the smell of rust makes me think I’m in the mine. Am I asleep? I hear metal boots. A man walking through the fog. I can’t see his face. But something stirs in me. Father? No, not Father. I squint.

units.source_en: Fog and shadows are my vision.
For a moment, the smell of rust makes me think I’m in the mine.
A man walking through the fog.

paragraphs.source_en: His voice jerks me violently back into the hold of the ship. Like a fishing hook tearing silk a direction it doesn’t wish to go.

units.source_en: His voice jerks me violently back into the hold of the ship.
Like a fishing hook tearing silk a direction it doesn’t wish to go.

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh. I’m glad it’s you,” I say quietly, finding enough strength to lift my heavy head a bit more to look him in his eyes. Tears fill them. He coughs out a laugh. The wind whistles behind me. Not the Vale. Just Mars. Not mist. Just the clouds. The ramp’s down so they can push my body out. I told Arcos I was never meant to have gray hair.

units.source_en: I’m glad it’s you,” I say quietly, finding enough strength to lift my heavy head a bit more to look him in his eyes.
The ramp’s down so they can push my body out.
I told Arcos I was never meant to have gray hair.

paragraphs.source_en: My head dips. I spit out some blood in my mouth. I’m nauseous and fading. “Tell Mustang … Eo … I love them.” I yawn so deeply.

units.source_en: I spit out some blood in my mouth.

paragraphs.source_en: “You bloodydamn fool,” he says in a low whisper, shaking his head. “I had it under control.”

units.source_en: “You bloodydamn fool,” he says in a low whisper, shaking his head.

paragraphs.source_en: “I didn’t …” I blink through the fog. “What?”

units.source_en: “I didn’t …” I blink through the fog.

paragraphs.source_en: “It is me,” he says. “It’s always been me, boyo.”
The fog disappears. I look up at him. I look up at Ares as he dons his Rage Knight helmet and shoots his pulseFist back at the Praetorians, sending them scattering. He tosses back a sonic grenade.

ja.t: をかぶり、プレトリアンたちに
けてパルスフィストを

units.source_en: He tosses back a sonic grenade.

paragraphs.source_en: An explosion. Something hits my chest and I’m falling. Tumbling. Flying? Sense cold. Ragged wind biting me. Stomach in my throat. Spinning. Then a rigid arm under mine. Rising. Wind whips past my ears. But there’s another sound before the darkness swallows me. Fitchner—Ares—terrorist lord of the underworld, howls like a wolf as he carries me to safe harbor.

Then a rigid arm under mine.
